newsitem.title: USA: AIG credit unit forms U.K. subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: AIG credit unit forms U.K. subsidiary.

text.p: American International Group Inc said its A.I. Credit Corp has formed a wholly-owned U.K. subsidiary called AIG Credit (UK) Ltd.
A.I. Credit Corp also has opened a San Juan, Puerto Rico branch office.
AIG Credit (UK) Ltd will finance commercial and personal lines insurance policies underwritten by carriers with an A.M. Best's rating of B+ or better, AIG said.
The subsidiary also will provide customized premium financing products, including premium audit financing, premium financing for industry groups or associations, and letter of credit replacement.
AIG Credit (UK) Ltd. handles all billing and collection functions for its brokers on accounts which it finances, AIG said.
Thomas Yaeger has been named executive vice president and Richard Harris senior vice president of AIG Credit (UK) Ltd.
A.I. Credit Corp's San Juan branch will offer a wide variety of financial products for the property-casualty industry, AIG said.
Eduardo Criado has been named general manager of A.I. Credit Corp.
